hook: Tired of design handoffs being a nightmare? What if your design tool spoke YOUR code language?
body: Penpot is the game-changer! This open-source design and prototyping tool enables seamless collaboration between designers and developers. Forget proprietary formats; Penpot uses SVG, making it incredibly code-friendly. Build better products faster by truly integrating design and development, all with a powerful, free, and collaborative platform.
cta: Ready to revolutionize your workflow? Check out Penpot in the comments!
